feedTitle: Shipping forecast for the North Irish Sea

items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 11 October 2026 10:15pm
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Sunday, 11 October 2026 at 10:15pm by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Strong winds.


##Synopsis##

Low pressure in the Atlantic will drive frontal troughs across the area overnight and tomorrow.


##Wind##

Southeast 4 or 5, increasing 5 or 6 overnight, decreasing 4 or 5 through tomorrow morning, veering south or southwest 5 or 6 in the evening.


##State of Sea##

Slight or moderate.


##Weather##

Fair at first, then occasional rain or drizzle arriving. Areas of mist and isolated fog patches later.


##Visibility##

Good, falling moderate or poor in rain/drizzle/mist. Very poor in fog patches.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

South or southwest 5 or 6, increasing 6 or 7 overnight, veering west or southwest 5 or 6 Tuesday morning.


##State of Sea##

Slight or moderate, soon building moderate or rough, then slight or moderate again later.


##Weather##

Occasional rain/drizzle/mist clearing to isolated showers later. Small risk of fog patches until later.


##Visibility##

Good, falling moderate or poor in rain/drizzle/mist. Very poor in any fog patches.
